label: D42-fokus-setelah-provisioning-aman
decision: Which focus should the next autonomous iteration of Anastrophe build, now that secure provisioning (ADR-0039/0040) is done and two security decisions (ADR-0038, ADR-0041) await the user?

candidates.description: FR-60: in-app FAQ screen with per-channel answers in Indonesian and English, reachable from the Keys tab, following the iOS design-system page; app-only with snapshot/structure tests and a simulator check.

Fix the verified deferred minors from the lifecycle, provisioning and invitation reviews (status-guarded updates, denylist max not_after and purge, refresher concurrency and pre-feature cards, required secret parameters, idempotency tests, link-base validation, printing invitation id). No new user-facing feature.
FR-05/FR-10: Release 'Tambah kartu' flow behind protocols with mocked device registration and NFC reading; live wiring waits for accounts, App Attest and a physical iPhone.

evidence_refs: docs/agentmemory/backlog.md (minor tertunda siklus hidup, provisioning, undangan)
priorities: 1) Do not pre-empt pending user decisions. 2) Prefer a missing P0 requirement or correctness/robustness work that reduces real risk. 3) Verifiable in the simulator or with the local backend without hardware or an Apple team. 4) Bounded to one plan of 3–5 tasks.
requirements: Does not implement or pre-empt ADR-0038, ADR-0041, ADR-0017 or ADR-0022.
Delivers either a currently missing P0 requirement or a measurable reduction of verified defects.
Can be verified in the iOS simulator or with the local backend, without a physical iPhone, reader hardware, or an Apple Developer team.
